topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I can't believe this, I mean, how do you just... forget someone? We spent every summer together, didn't we? Built all those crazy forts in the woods, remember? The time we climbed that tree and got stuck? We thought we were invincible. I feel like a part of me just doesn’t make sense anymore, like a chapter’s missing from my story. I don’t know how to talk to you now, it's like you’re a stranger, but I keep expecting the old you to show up, laughing at some old joke only we knew. Maybe I just need time to figure out what this means. I hope you can understand.
